The current acceleration line remains render-sampled. Shoe-bottom positions come from visible rendered avatar geometry; stance is a gait-phase estimate, not Rapier foot contact. Stance speed uses intervals with both endpoints in stance. Capsule margin derives from centerline-to-edge samples at 0.05 m spacing; it is a collision-map estimate, not direct physical contact or a guarantee over unsampled positions. Schema-backed demo venue

Synthetic dev fixture validated by BuildingLayout schema v2, then adapted through decodeLayout. It is not a measured or customer venue. Supported source fields shown here: 2 floors, 4 room records, 1 abstract portals, 6 adapted floor objects, 2 authored instances, 2 authored walls and 2 wall openings. The rendered floor has no underlay image; boundaries, walkable zones, booths, and portal entry points come from supported schema fields.

Role access is a lab-local explicit allow-list. BuildingLayout has no role ACL or per-zone visibility field; this does not demonstrate venue security.

fixture-escalator · escalator · motion-lab-ground ↔ motion-lab-mezzanine

Portal entries are schema-supported route metadata, not authored traversal paths or proof of stairs/escalator/elevator collision. Route offers across floors must be treated as unavailable until validated physical geometry exists.

Resolved telemetry

Observational telemetry sampled after the mounted follower frame update. Velocity, acceleration and jerk use observed frame intervals; a boundary frame resets derivatives on playback or floor changes. Tick is per playback generation. The separate live panel reports fixed-step auto/manual acceleration and explicit acceptance thresholds; fixture diagnostics remain non-authoritative.

Blue speed · amber acceleration · pink jerk; series normalize independently. Gaze vector: —.

Teal clearance decision (gaps mean unavailable) · purple/pink left/right stance estimates. Feet are gait estimates, not measured contact; unavailable connector clearance remains unverified.

Flat-walk feet are world targets from the shared gait phase; contact is an estimate, not Rapier foot contact. Connector-specific foot samples are unavailable here. Capsule gate reports clear/blocker/source; the shared validator does not expose numeric wall clearance.
